title: Persistence of a finite relative mapping cone in a filtered colimit
statement:
Use the universes, coherent quasicategories, mapping spaces and homotopy fibers of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], small filtered infinity categories and finite simplicial sets of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], $\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ of [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model], and left cones $K^{\triangleleft}=\Delta^0\star K$ of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Let $B$ be a small infinity category and $D:I\to\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty/B}$ a small filtered coherent diagram with structural functors $p_j:E_j\to B$. Let $p:E\to B$ with legs $r_j$ be a slice colimiting cocone whose underlying total cocone is colimiting. Fix $i\in I$, a finite simplicial set $K$, a coherent cone $q:K^{\triangleleft}\to E_i$ and its base cone $\beta=p_iq$. Write $c=q(*)$, $d=q|_K$, and $\beta_k:\beta(*)\to\beta(k)$ for its legs, including their higher cone compatibilities. For $u:i\to j$, write $c_u=D(u)c$, $d_u=D(u)d$, and $q_u=D(u)q$; the coherent structural maps to $B$ identify their base cones with $\beta$. Suppose that for every such $u$, every $z\in E_j$ and every base arrow $h:p_j(z)\to\beta(*)$, postcomposition with the legs of $q_u$ gives an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Map}_{E_j}^{h}(z,c_u)\longrightarrow\lim_{k\in K}\operatorname{Map}_{E_j}^{\beta_k h}(z,d_u(k)).$$
The diagram of spaces on the right uses postcomposition along $d_u$ and the compatibilities in $\beta$. Then for every $z\in E$ and $h:p(z)\to\beta(*)$, the image cone $r_iq$ gives an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Map}_{E}^{h}(z,r_ic)\longrightarrow\lim_{k\in K}\operatorname{Map}_{E}^{\beta_k h}(z,r_id(k)).$$
All base-arrow identifications retain the structural coherences of the slice diagram. Empty $K$ is allowed; its limit is a terminal space. No operad, cocartesian-lift existence, or full faithfulness of transition functors is assumed.
